coverageNotes: Naturkartan/Västervik GPX is available for all 9 main stages plus connectors/loops.
OSM stages 1-8 are QA cross-checks; there is no clean OSM Tjustleden relation for stage 9.
The official 200 km figure includes loops/connectors; the 9 main stages sum to about 159 km by official stage distances.
Branch/connectors remain separate from the 9-stage mainline unless the runtime import explicitly supports tails/connectors.

geometryPlan.secondarySource: OSM relation quality/contamination resolved: official GPX primary; OSM polluted/mislabeled QA-only.
geometryPlan.distancePolicy: Use current official section distance as primary public/display; store computed GPX separately as geometryDerivedDistanceKm.
geometryPlan.directionPolicy: Normalize displayed/imported geometry to official written order; reverse sections 4 and 6; keep source direction metadata.
geometryPlan.endpointPolicy: Do not silently snap GPX endpoints to shelters/transit/parking/OSM; preserve endpoints and model nearby clusters/tails/connectors with provenance.

sectionSpecificActions.action: Reverse official GPX in normalization and preserve sourceDirection/directionRelativeToOfficialOrder metadata.
Reverse official GPX in normalization and preserve sourceDirection/directionRelativeToOfficialOrder metadata. Keep the OSM 2018 reroute note south of Sixgölen as QA/currentness context.
Keep Etapp 8 final 111.4 m Lermon shelter/end tail; Etapp 9 starts at shared earlier vertex; treat tail as Etapp 8 terminal/facility tail not gap/duplicate.

Use raw official Etapp 9 GPX as canonical Tjustleden stage line from Lermon to Östgötaleden/länsgränsen handoff; model Falerum continuation as documented endpoint access tail/connector, not silent mutation.

unknowns: unknown/recheck: final normalized geometry before protected-area and water-area overlays.
unknown/recheck: authoritative import mapping for loops/connectors/tails before runtime import.

policy: Only high-confidence on-route exact coords; pending/approx/commercial/currentness/off-route remain pending/access metadata.
Rural sparse/school-calendar stops caveated; trip-date verification.
Default main-stage potable water/trail waste suppressed unless exact/current official point-source evidence; natural water not potable evidence.
candidateImports: Promote only high-confidence, on-route, exact-coordinate facilities after coordinate/currentness verification.
Use endpoint clusters for shelters, parking, transit, and access points where the GPX endpoint and facility/access point are near but not identical.
pendingOrSuppressedFacilities: Pending/suppress/access metadata do not block route import; coordinate/currentness verify facilities before import.
Transit/parking converted-to-pre-import-check: do not block route normalization; keep confidence/caveats/access distance; trip-date KLT/Östgötatrafiken/Krösatågen/heritage rail; legal parking verify.
No fresh-water sources along trail per overview; suppress natural water as potable unless reliable point source verified.
unknown/recheck: exact Mörtfors shelter/toilet, KLT/GTFS, protected overlays, parking, service currentness, and individual section facility coordinates where marked open in the section packets.

staticWarningsToCarry: Fireplaces present but fire bans/restrictions dynamic.
Acute notices, fire bans, SMHI fire risk, forestry passability, service hours, timetables are import-day checks.
dynamicPublicationChecks: 2026-04-30 acute-info recheck still showed current notices for Etapp 6 only, but currentness remains publication-day.
Protected/water area overlays converted-to-import-grade-gis-check: require final overlays after endpoint/tail/reversal decisions; apply rules only affected segments.
Recheck KLT/Östgötatrafiken/Krösatågen/heritage rail and legal parking before public display.
Recheck fire bans/restrictions and SMHI fire risk before publication.

importOrder: 1. Confirm runtime schema/import support for officialDistanceKm, computedGeometryDistanceKm, endpoint clusters, tails/connectors, and source-direction reversal metadata.
2. Import/parse the 9 section packets in official Mörtfors-to-Falerum order.
3. Normalize official GPX geometry, reversing sections 4 and 6 and preserving source direction metadata.
4. Apply official-distance display policy while storing computed geometry distances for QA.
5. Preserve GPX endpoints and model nearby facilities, access points, tails, and connectors as separate provenance-bearing clusters.
6. Apply final protected/water-area overlays after endpoint/tail/reversal decisions.
7. Promote only verified high-confidence facilities; keep pending, approximate, commercial/currentness, and off-route items pending/access metadata.
8. Run dynamic acute/fire/forestry/service/transit checks before publication.

blockers.description: Route normalization is still not runtime-import-ready until the importer/schema can represent officialDistanceKm, computedGeometryDistanceKm, endpoint clusters, tails/connectors, and source-direction reversal metadata.
Importers should support officialDistanceKm and computedGeometryDistanceKm; caveat material differences.

openDecisionsForUser.decision: Allow candidate importer/schema work before runtime import so officialDistanceKm, computedGeometryDistanceKm, endpoint clusters, tails/connectors, and source-direction reversal metadata can be represented.
Keep loops/connectors out of the main 9-stage route unless the import supports separate connector/tail objects.
Suppress natural water as potable unless reliable point-source evidence is verified.

validationChecklist: No runtime app data, generated public data, shared scripts, or package files changed.
All 9 section files are represented in sectionCoverage.
Schema/import-support blockers from normalization-decisions.json are preserved.
Sections 4 and 6 reversal requirements are carried into geometryPlan.
Etapp 8 Lermon tail and Etapp 9 Falerum endpoint/access-tail decisions are carried into geometryPlan.
Facility plan suppresses unverified potable water and keeps weak transit/parking as pre-import checks.
Dynamic acute, fire, forestry, service, and transit checks remain publication blockers.

statusDetails.summary: Phase 1 overview and Phase 2 section research are complete for Etapp 1-9. Blocker triage and normalization decisions are captured in normalization-decisions.json. Keep research-only until runtime schema/import mapping supports the documented distance, direction, endpoint, tail, connector, and source-direction metadata.
